lesson_title: Five Graphs, One Sentence: Functions Revision
hook_text: Every graph you learned this year is the SAME machine with two controls.
clip_script: Every function equation is a machine fitted with two controls, and revision turns simple the instant you notice the controls are identical on every machine. Control one: q, the jack. Whatever the basic shape does, plus q hoists the whole picture; minus q lowers it. Control two: a, the stretch slider with a mirror switch. Push the slider up and the shape intensifies: steeper line, narrower bowl, taller wave. Flick the switch to negative and the picture reflects: bowls become domes, rising lines fall, waves open downward.
visual_style: Five glowing graphs on one wall — line, bowl, hyperbola, exponential, wave — all rising together as a jack lifts them, then flipping in unison when the mirror switch clicks.
pacing: Calm setup, twin beats on the jack lift and the mirror flip, quick gallery sweep to close.
call_to_action: Watch the full revision sweep and sketch any graph with one checklist.
